senses.definition: n.pr.m. (Yah comforts, 𝔊 Νεεμιας (-ου). etc.;—n.pr. נחמיה(ו) on Isr. scarab in BM, Cl GannJAs 1883, Fév.-Mars. 156 No. 42);—
the son of Hachaliah, governor of Judah under Artaxerxes Longimanus Ne 1:1; 8:9; 10:2; 12:26, 47.
ruler of half the district of Bethzur Ne 3:16.
one of twelve heads of people who returned with Zerubbabel Ezr 2:2 = Ne 7:7.
